name: LG 22" 75Hz Monitor
verdict: The cheapest screen that doesn't hurt. Fine for study and office; gamers will outgrow 75Hz in a year.
why: IPS panel with honest colors at this price. 75Hz is smooth enough for daily use and light gaming.
skipIf: You play competitive FPS — save for 144Hz.

name: Acer 24" 100Hz Monitor
verdict: The sweet spot. 100Hz feels twice as smooth as 60Hz and 24 inch fits small desks.
why: Biggest noticeable jump per rupee in this whole database. Everyone who upgrades says the same.
skipIf: Desk narrower than 3 feet — take the 22 inch.

name: LG UltraGear 24" 144Hz
verdict: Real competitive monitor. Only buy if your PC/matces push 100+ fps, else wasted.
why: 144Hz with 1ms response. The dream pick for Valorant/BGMI-emulator grinders.
cons: Needs a real GPU to shine

name: Redgear Mechanical Keyboard
verdict: Clicky, loud, indestructible. Best typing-per-rupee under 2k, but your family will hear it.
why: Real mechanical switches at membrane prices. Survives chai spills better than it should.
skipIf: Shared room at night — too loud.

name: Royal Kludge RK61 Wireless
verdict: Tiny, wireless, hot-swappable. The desk-space saver that starts the minimal-desk dream.
why: 60% size frees mouse room. Bluetooth + 2.4GHz both work. Needs a week to learn arrows layer.
skipIf: You need numpad daily — take full size.

name: Logitech G304 Wireless
verdict: The default answer. Light, 250-hour battery, sensor good enough for ranked play.
why: Hero sensor at this price killed the budget-gaming-mouse debate. Two years of community proof.

name: Logitech MX Master 3S
verdict: An office chair for your hand. Silent clicks, sideways scroll — excel and timelines feel different.
why: Ergonomics you feel after 5–8 hour days. Quiet clicks save shared rooms. Not for competitive FPS.

name: Boya BY-M1 Mic
verdict: My daily mic. 6m wire, no battery tension, clear voice with fan on. Needs Open Camera on Realme.
why: Lapel on collar beats any room mic under 2k for noisy Indian rooms. The wire is the feature.

name: K8 Wireless Mic
verdict: Freedom mic for walking videos. Slight delay on old phones, robotic in silent rooms.
why: No wire changes how you shoot. Buy for movement, not for room quality.
skipIf: Room-only videos — Boya is clearer and cheaper.

name: 10-inch Ring Light with Stand
verdict: Face videos go from dull to alive. Flimsy stand — keep away from table edges.
why: Light position matters more than camera. This is the cheapest good light there is.
skipIf: Room already bright with window light.

name: Green Soul Office Chair
verdict: Your back will thank you. The single highest comfort-per-rupee in any setup — prioritize this.
why: 5–8 hour days punish stools and plastic chairs. Lumbar + adjustable arms change posture in a week.

name: Neon Budget Office Chair
verdict: Okay back support at half the price. Fine starter; upgrade the chair before the monitor.
why: Does the basics — cushion, backrest, wheels. Wobbles sooner than premium ones.
skipIf: Back pain already — stretch to Green Soul.

name: Wakefit Study Table
verdict: Solid, right height, fits monitor + keyboard + chai. The desk nobody regrets.
why: Engineered wood that doesn't wobble when you type hard. Right depth for 24 inch screens.

name: Folding Table (Budget)
verdict: A table that folds away. Slight wobble, unbeatable flexibility for hostel rooms.
why: Hostel hero — study by day, floor space by night.

name: Mini Tripod + Mobile Holder
verdict: The ₹499 that unlocks top-down shots and stable calls. Buy before any upgrade.
why: Shaky hands ruin more videos than bad mics. This fixes it for the price of a pizza.

name: 1080p USB Webcam
verdict: Better than any laptop camera. Ring light + this = pro calls.
why: Laptop cams look up your nose in bad light. Fixed angle + 1080p changes meetings.
